protocols.name: Lysis
protocols.description: Cell lysis to release RNA from siliques and tobacco fruit tissue.

parameters.name: lysis buffer composition
parameters.description: Buffer used for cell disruption; specific composition not detailed in protocol

parameters.name: homogenization method
parameters.description: Mechanical disruption technique such as grinding or bead-beating

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Temperature during lysis; not specified in protocol

protocols.name: RNA Partitioning 1
protocols.description: Phase separation to isolate RNA into aqueous phase using phenol-based reagent.

parameters.name: phase separation reagent
parameters.description: Reagent used for RNA phase separation

parameters.name: centrifugation speed
parameters.description: Speed setting for centrifuge during phase separation

parameters.name: centrifugation temperature
parameters.description: Temperature during centrifugation; typically 4°C

protocols.name: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 1
protocols.description: Precipitation of nucleic acids from aqueous phase using alcohol and salt.

parameters.name: precipitation agent
parameters.description: Alcohol used for nucleic acid precipitation

parameters.name: salt concentration
parameters.description: Concentration of salt (e.g., sodium acetate) to aid precipitation

parameters.name: centrifugation duration
parameters.description: Time for centrifugation to pellet nucleic acids

protocols.name: RNA Partitioning 2
protocols.description: Second round of RNA phase separation to further purify RNA.

parameters.name: re-extraction buffer
parameters.description: Buffer used to resuspend pellet before second partitioning

parameters.name: phase separation reagent
parameters.description: Reagent for second phase separation

parameters.name: centrifugation speed
parameters.description: Speed setting for centrifuge during second partitioning

protocols.name: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 2
protocols.description: Second precipitation of RNA to concentrate and desalt.

parameters.name: precipitation agent
parameters.description: Alcohol used for second precipitation

parameters.name: centrifugation duration
parameters.description: Duration of centrifugation to pellet RNA

parameters.name: washing agent
parameters.description: Ethanol concentration used for washing pellet

protocols.name: Nucleic Acid Precipitation 3
protocols.description: Final precipitation step to ensure complete recovery of RNA.

parameters.name: centrifugation speed
parameters.description: Speed setting for final centrifugation

parameters.name: centrifugation time
parameters.description: Duration of final centrifugation

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Temperature during final precipitation

protocols.name: Resuspension and Storage
protocols.description: RNA pellet is resuspended in RNase-free water or buffer and stored.

parameters.name: resuspension volume
parameters.description: Volume of buffer used to dissolve RNA pellet

parameters.name: storage temperature
parameters.description: RNA stored at -80°C for long-term or -20°C for short-term

parameters.name: resuspension buffer
parameters.description: Buffer used to solubilize RNA
